title: Halloween Candies
description: adds the big 4 of Canadian Halloween candies!
body:
This mod adds candies from Canada! Each of them gives their own effects!

try them out in game to figure out what they all do! but be careful as some of them might not do things expectedly!

*note this mod is only available for 1.21.8+, if there is enough demand for different versions they will be released*
